stem: [16~17] 다음을 듣고, 남자가 하는 말의 주제로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

script.speaker: M
script.text: Good afternoon, everyone. Summer is a season when food can spoil easily. Today I'd like to talk about how to prevent food poisoning. First, wash your hands with soap before you prepare or eat food. Second, keep food cold and put leftovers in the refrigerator quickly. Third, cook meat and fish thoroughly. Finally, throw away any food that has been left out for more than two hours.

why: 손 씻기, 차게 보관, 충분히 익히기, 오래된 음식 버리기 등 식중독 예방 방법을 소개합니다.
